name: Jennifer L. Selin
summary: Research expertise in administrative law and accountability.
bio_html: Jennifer L. Selin is an Associate Professor of Law at ASU’s Sandra Day O’Connor College of Law. Her research explores the democratic accountability of the administrative state. She has written extensively on the responsiveness of federal administrators to the President and Congress and how administrative structure affects policy implementation. Dr. Selin’s scholarship has been published in law, political science, and public administration journals and has been utilized by the Obama, Trump, and Biden Administrations, Congress, the Supreme Court, and the media. Prior to joining ASU, Dr. Selin was a senior attorney advisor at the Administrative Conference of the United States and served as an assistant professor at the Universities of Illinois and Missouri. Dr. Selin is proud graduate of Lebanon Valley College and holds a J.D. from Wake Forest University and a Ph.D. from Vanderbilt University.
